items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics data quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors exist. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and permit only bounded reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or security-sensitive exposure. Continue the existing read-only evidence work only; do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, deploy, requeue failures, add dependencies, or conduct external outreach.
